imputation_criteria.bilirubina_missing: hepatic normality if no recent value is available
imputation_criteria.creatinina_plaquetes_missing: not imputed as normal; requires observed, pre-return, or forward-filled value
imputation_criteria.renal: renal component calculated from creatinine; DIURESIS excluded due to missingness
imputation_criteria.initial_missing_sofa_labs: no longitudinal delta until first day with creatinine and platelets
imputation_criteria.critical_care_return: critical-care return >72h starts a new baseline segment
imputation_criteria.sepsis: delta SOFA >= 2 from the current operational baseline
imputation_criteria.vasopressors: without dose, dobutamine/dopamine raise minimum score to 2 and noradrenaline/adrenaline to 3
